title: Register as a migration agent to give immigration assistance
what: A person who is not a registered migration agent must not give immigration assistance.

sources.title: Migration Act 1958
sources.quote: 280 Restrictions on giving of immigration assistance (1) Subject to this section, a person who is not a registered migration agent must not give immigration assistance.

sources.title: Migration Act 1958
sources.quote: Division 3—Registration of migration agents 287 Register of Migration Agents (1) The Migration Agents Registration Authority must keep a register, to be known as the Register of Migration Agents, listing individuals who are registered as migration agents.
